## TRA Timeline

#### HACII business combination announcement

- 2012-05-16: 8-K announces Equity Purchase Agreement and Cross Purchase Agreement with HACII; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit A to the Cross Purchase Agreement
- 2012-06-20: Amendment No. 1 to Equity Purchase Agreement adds the TRA to the "Ancillary Agreements" definition; no substantive change to the form-of TRA

#### Abandonment

- 2012-07-06: Final 8-K referencing HACII; subsequent 2013 filings show Appvion operating independently, indicating the SPAC combination was abandoned and the TRA never executed

## Explanation

In May 2012, Appvion's then-parent Paperweight Development Corp. signed a Cross Purchase Agreement with the SPAC Hicks Acquisition Company II, Inc. that contemplated a business combination in which HACII would become Appvion's public parent and would enter into an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with PDC covering basis step-ups from PDC's exchanges of Appleton Class B Exchangeable Units. The form-of TRA appeared as an exhibit to the Cross Purchase Agreement but carried a blank preamble date, consistent with an unexecuted form. The HACII combination was abandoned before closing: filings after July 2012 make no further reference to HACII, and Appvion continued under its own CIK with an independent 2013 debt refinancing. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
